newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner reorganises private banking in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner reorganises private banking in Germany.

text.p: Dresdner Bank AG said on Thursday it will wind up its private banking unit Hardy & Co Privatbankiers and integrate it into the group to boost its share of the market for managing wealthy clients' money.

The bank said it would assemble a team in Germany to specialise in advising clients with complex wealth structures. The bank said its private banking services were already well established outside Germany.
Dresdner's announcement follows a move by its rival Deutsche Bank AG to concentrate its private banking business in Germany at its subsidiary Bankhaus Grunelius KG.
Deutsche late last year acquired the shares in Grunelius it did not already own but, unlike Dresdner, will maintain the bank as a separate unit.
